title: Search service roadmap
goal: Customers find the right document on the first search, and the team can ship search changes every week without breaking anything.
rule: We work only from this roadmap. Any change needs the program lead's approval, or a genuinely good reason stated in the next update. Updates are short and come when an issue is done or a gate result arrives.

gates.D: Design agreed with the program lead before building
gates.R: Independent review, every finding fixed and re-checked, pipeline green on the exact head
gates.S: Screen gate: every screen at every width, light and dark, accessibility checks

epics.name: Better ranking

epics.name: Safe weekly releases
epics.note: A change cannot reach customers until the checks that matter have passed.
